gap_description.definition: y-axis shows a continuous numeric scale from 0 up to ~400 with evenly spaced tick marks; no sudden jumps or omitted ranges are apparent.
x-axis is categorical (genotype labels) and does not imply a continuous numeric scale requiring a break.
